command: cd /code && for f in calibration_error.R lss1_summary_analyses.R lss2_summary_analyses.R lss2_peak_analyses.R; do echo 'RUNNING' $f; Rscript $f > /results/${f%.R}.out.txt 2> /results/${f%.R}.err.txt; status=$?; echo $f status=$status; done && ls -l /results && echo '---tail errs---' && for e in /results/*.err.txt; do echo '###' $(basename $e); tail -n 20 $e; done
